name: The Academy: Love Potions
source:
Welcome to the academy!
Play as Emilia on her adventure at the school for magical creatures.
Meet her friends Madelune, Sin, and Cendre, and experience a day like no other! But don't forget to pay attention in Potions class...

[Translated from [url=https://diane1f0cd.itch.io/the-academy-love-potions-fr]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到学院！
扮演艾米莉亚，在魔法生物学校展开冒险。
认识她的朋友Madelune、Sin和Cendre，体验与众不同的一天！但别忘了在魔药课上注意……

[译自[url=https://diane1f0cd.itch.io/the-academy-love-potions-fr]Itch.io[/url]]
